buzzwordSlayer.reality: Warp Mode provides thrilling acceleration but drains the battery extremely fast; use it only for quick overtaking maneuvers in city traffic.
The onboard navigation works beautifully but requires an active monthly subscription plan after the initial trial period ends.
The battery and motor can easily handle deep water puddles, but avoid high-pressure washing near the dashboard console area.
Regen braking helps recover energy smoothly, but do not rely on it entirely to stop the vehicle; use physical brakes for sudden stops.
